_: Per-file size budgets for ui/src, and the shell rule for App.tsx, read by
scripts/gates/composition.py. THIS FILE IS THE ALLOWLIST — it is the one
source, and docs/architecture/ui.md 11.7 links here rather than restating it.
A budget is a ceiling, not a target. The gate fails when a file exceeds its
budget, and when a file over default_max_lines has no entry at all. It does
NOT fail when a count drops: ratchet the number down as the file shrinks.
.ts is in scope as well as .tsx. Capping only components would let any
component meet its cap by moving the logic into a helper beside it.
'bespoke' means a deliberate exception — the file is one cohesive thing and
splitting it would invent a boundary the behaviour does not have.
'debt' means a file that should shrink, tracked by an issue. Debt is not an
exception; it is a number that should be going down.

ui/src/App.tsx.note: Being split into feature-owned components. Was 3274. Ratchet this down as each extraction lands; the target is a composition shell under 250.

ui/src/api/ipc.ts.note: The whole typed IPC surface. It is one chokepoint on purpose (implementation/frontend.md), and the Setting union is the only registry of setting keys — splitting it would give that registry two homes.

ui/src/Editor.tsx.note: CodeMirror host: extension assembly, the imperative EditorApi, and the anchor-scroll queue.

ui/src/Properties.tsx.note: The frontmatter table and its per-type cell dispatch.

ui/src/editor/decorations.ts.note: One Lezer tree walk producing every Live Preview decoration. Splitting by mark type would mean several walks, against the measured-performance bar.

ui/src/sidebar/SearchPanel.tsx.note: Query state, result grouping and the roving-tabindex result list.

ui/src/ast/normalize.ts.note: Mirrors the Rust normalizer. Divergence is a correctness bug, so it stays one file that can be diffed against its counterpart.

ui/src/sidebar/IntegrityPanel.tsx.note: Vault-health rows and their fetch effect.

ui/src/settings/settingsState.ts.note: The vault's persisted configuration surface: one signal, one setter and one hydrate step per setting. Length here tracks the number of settings, not tangled logic.

ui/src/statusbar/PendingRewrites.tsx.note: The pending-rewrites popover and its per-row apply.

ui/src/omnibar/OmniBar.tsx.note: The ranked multi-kind palette named as the one deliberately bespoke surface in architecture/ui.md 11.6.

ui/src/sidebar/UnlinkedMentions.tsx.note: Mention rows plus the untrack-your-own-writes fetch effect.

ui/src/editor/dataview.ts.note: The dataview runner: query dispatch, result cache and invalidation as one unit.

ui/src/core/commands.ts.note: The command/keymap registry. It is the single source of truth for command ids, defaults and key matching (architecture/ui.md 11.2); splitting it would create a second place to register a command.

./api/ipc.note: App still owns the document session, vault boot and the watcher listeners, which are the direct IPC callers. The waiver goes away with those extractions; do not add a second waiver to keep an IPC call in the shell.
